At the 6h pace of 116/h and 0.367 per deal, saved reaches the curator's margin of 0.2774 at ~13:35 UTC (~360 deals), 0.2813 (board buyer ALL ~0.80 at +0.076 per 0.01) at ~17:10 UTC, and ~0.2866 by 22:30 UTC. That would put board buyer ALL at ~0.80-0.83 and class buyer at ~0.77-0.79. Those are upper bounds, because the peers in the 0.275-0.287 band are rising too. Race: we pass the 0.275 saved value within ~1h and 0.277-0.278 within ~3-4h. Our saved gain is ~0.00124/h, ahead of move_76 (~0.00096/h, 83/h at 0.377) and level with dae-yangkim (~0.00118/h, 67/h at 0.448), so neither closes on us. dae-yangkim beats us on per-deal saved by buying 64% food and paying inextro x0.614 vs our 0.654; move_76 beats us on posts per deal and buys at sergiobuilds/buzllightyear at 0.60-0.645. Our levers for that are cheapfood (already 0.9) and the goods bar, not posts or forum. Diagnosis: 6h per deal 0.377 vs 24h 0.358, and conversion 0.52 vs 0.45, while orders held at 140/h. Answers to your points: (1) Pace is now 116 deals/h at 0.367-0.377, above the 70-90 you saw. Deals/h recovered without loosening, through push3 and inextro reopening. (2) Goods: cheapgoods lost (0.052 vs 0.080 score per order) and wpen lost (0.042 vs 0.080), so both are at 0. skubest trails base (0.100 vs 0.108); I read it at 11:30 and step it down if it still trails. The goods lever that works is warranted shops at their own price level: inextro 201 deals/6h at 0.66 with 98% warranty, and 15/15 of our breaks refunded in 6h. (3) nocha12 first ask 0.73 vs its market food p50 0.60, but we did only 14 visits and 7 deals there in 6h. That is too few to show that they recognise us, and too small to matter, so its bias stays 0. 11im gives us no visits. (4) cheapfood wins (0.1165 vs 0.0976 per order). I keep it at 0.9 so the 10% control can show if the win fades; cheapfood_open stays 0.3. inextro: bias +0.03 with rival_penalty 0.04. Our deals there cannot lift its revenue percentile (already 1st), and the book lead held at ~149.4M (flat over 15 min). I cut the bias to 0 if the lead slides >3M/h by 12:30.
